description: Retires the reasoning budget contract. Agents cannot read their effective reasoning level, so the exact-cap directive stopped every execution that carried it, and Meridian's CLI never enforced it. Reasoning management is removed from the managed Governed SDD text; a project that wants a reasoning policy writes its own outside the managed blocks. It also states that a local main ahead of the fetched origin/main does not block integration. It also states in the managed git-workflow text when a stop is valid, that a gate is never satisfied by writing false state, and that a state a Meridian command accepted is followed and recorded under Rule discrepancies:.
delta: In docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md the entire 'Reasoning budget contract' section (the capability=reasoning-budget-contract v1 marker, delimiters included) is deleted, and the execution-evidence-profile v4 text drops its sentence about the task's declared reasoning requirement. tasks/TASK_BLUEPRINT.md (task-blueprint v14) no longer carries the Reasoning and Reasoning justification fields or their explanatory paragraph. docs/LIFECYCLE_ORCHESTRATION.md (lifecycle-orchestration v9) no longer requires the orchestrator to configure or confirm a worker reasoning value. PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md (execution-assets v4) no longer lists reasoning profiles. Unmarked text that required choosing, recording, matching, or escalating a reasoning level is removed from the context policy, operator prompts, pull request policy, and execution evidence profile. Existing tasks that still carry the fields are not an error. The same blueprint's ## Validation guidance now states that every command proving an acceptance criterion or an Evidence needed item has its own declared validation ID, that one ID holds exactly one command, that output paths are fixed and task-scoped (for example target/<TASK-ID>/), and that commands use no mktemp, $(...), or time-based paths; this is wording only, validation parsing is unchanged, and existing tasks that declare fewer IDs are not an error. The git-workflow block (v12 in the Governed SDD PROJECT_WORKFLOW.md, v11 in the three Lean Delivery workflow files) replaces 'stage from a clean primary checkout at origin/main' with: local main equals origin/main or is ahead of it with commits not yet pushed (pushed with the integration), and main behind the fetched origin/main is MAIN_BEHIND_ORIGIN. The same block adds a 'Stops and denials' section: a stop is valid only when backed by a BLOCKED <CODE> line from a Meridian command, a non-zero exit of a required command, or a nameable unmet acceptance criterion; a gate is never satisfied by writing false state and a gate that contradicts another rule stops with both rules reported; and a state a Meridian command accepted is followed and recorded under Rule discrepancies: in the handoff, except for actions on the deny list. The prose list of closure stop codes is replaced by a reference to capabilities/stop-codes-v1.json and meridian worktree closure-status. docs/COMPLETION_REPORT_TEMPLATE.md gains an optional Rule discrepancies: line.
verification: a Governed SDD project locked at 1.2.8 removes the reasoning-budget-contract block cleanly on upgrade when its copy is unmodified, and reports a blocking conflict when the block was locally modified
the upgraded task-blueprint v14 ## Validation guidance states the one-ID-per-command, fixed task-scoped output path, and no mktemp, $(...), or time-based path rules
no managed Governed SDD template requires choosing, recording, matching, confirming, or escalating a reasoning level

a clean Governed SDD upgrade installs git-workflow v12 and a clean Lean Delivery upgrade installs git-workflow v11, each stating that a local main ahead of origin/main does not block integration and that only a main behind the fetched origin/main is MAIN_BEHIND_ORIGIN
the upgraded git-workflow block states the stop validity rule, the false-state rule, and the Rule discrepancies: rule, and no longer lists closure stop codes in prose
python3 scripts/check_repository.py and python3 -m unittest discover -s tests pass
